html:
The unification of Saudi Arabia was the thirty-year campaign by Ibn Saud that joined most of the Arabian Peninsula into one kingdom, proclaimed on 23 September 1932 as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

From Riyadh, taken in 1902, he won Najd, the Gulf coast of al-Hasa from the Ottomans in 1913, and the Rashidi lands of Ha'il in 1921. His shock troops were the Ikhwan, Bedouin settled in religious farm colonies. In 1924 and 1925 he took the Hejaz with Mecca and Medina from the Hashemite king.

When the Ikhwan wanted to raid British-protected Iraq and Kuwait, he crushed them in 1929. The new state was poor until oil was found in 1938. September 23 is Saudi National Day.
sum: The unification of Saudi Arabia was the thirty-year campaign by Ibn Saud that joined most of the Arabian Peninsula into one kingdom, proclaimed on 23 September 1932 as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
